summary: Edit on every library the role has access to
notes: This workbook is the source of truth
Changes in who has access start here.
To change which role reaches which library: add or remove a mark on the Access Matrix tab and send the file back to IT.
Tell IT who, which role (a row of the matrix) and their sign-in address.
Add a row to the matrix and mark the libraries the role needs.
Add a column to the matrix and mark the roles that need it.
Do not edit the other tabs
They are generated from Entra ID. Editing them changes nothing in SharePoint.
